wrcg.description: WRC Generations — experimental telemetry and live pacenotes
wrcg.title: WRC Generations live pacenotes
wrcg.privilegeWarning: Run ZTMZ and WRC Generations at the same Windows privilege level, preferably both as a normal user.
wrcg.forwardedHint: Receive UDP from SimHub or another relay. ZTMZ will not change the game's telemetry destination.
wrcg.limitations: Experimental Windows bridge. Original game speech remains enabled. Stage/car names and synchronized countdown are not available yet. Finish detection uses the telemetry result time; penalties are not included. Unmapped calls are left to the original co-driver.
wrcg.warning: This experimental feature injects a DLL into WRC Generations and may affect game stability. Use offline. It remains loaded until the game exits. Continue?
wrcg.windowsOnly: The WRCG live bridge currently supports Windows only.
wrcg.unsupportedFmod: This FMOD version has not been verified; bridge injection was not performed.
